One swapOut couldn't read again as it went (SwapUnreadable, // HI-2612) is put back too, but isn't the user's change: unsettled, so the next open retires it. if (e instanceof SwapAbandoned && !(e instanceof SwapUnreadable)) log.info(`Kept the skill ${userText(id)}: it changed while Combwork was removing it, so it is the user's`) else later(`Could not look at or remove the renamed skill ${userText(id)}`, e) // i18n-ignore: a log line continue }
